name: K-C Neenah Experimental Mill - Neenah WI
type: Manufacturing / experimental mill (product & process innovation, Family Care)

fieldNotes.location: Roster lat/lng (44.185819,-88.462609, APPROXIMATE) landed in downtown Neenah - close. Web research (Wisconsin DNR Green Tier, Waze, Foursquare) gave the X-Mill / Experimental Mill at 126 N Commercial St - K-C's original Globe Mill site in the downtown core. Locked center 44.18830,-88.46260.
fieldNotes.site: This is an atypical site: a downtown-embedded R&D / experimental mill, NOT a freight-oriented plant or DC. The K-C campus occupies a riverfront block with the X-Mill industrial building, connected office buildings, a multi-story parking deck, and surface lots, fronting city streets on all sides. Heavy shadow in available imagery limits dock/structure detail.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No conventional truck gate at a public road. K-C-owned surface parking lots are fenced with chain-link sliding gates and internal service drives gate access into the campus. Marked truckGate=true on the basis of those controlled internal gates, but it is a soft call - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible anywhere on the urban campus.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true (gate present, no guard shack) - access is via card/badge-controlled sliding gates typical of urban campuses.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Loading is via recessed dock bays on the X-Mill industrial building's west/south faces; heavy shadow prevents a precise count. Estimated <10 doors - banded 0-10, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No drop yard or marked trailer-parking stalls - urban site with no yard space.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Any truck approach is a short urban service drive holding 1-2 trucks at most.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Tight downtown geometry - service drives connect directly to city streets; a truck queue would spill onto public streets.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: The K-C downtown campus is multiple connected buildings (X-Mill, office buildings, parking deck) - a campus.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Squarely Urban - dense downtown Neenah core with modern apartment blocks, retail, and parking decks on adjacent blocks.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~14 acres for the K-C-controlled riverfront block; soft estimate given the campus is interleaved with downtown streets.
fieldNotes.confidence: Medium overall - facility positively identified, but it is an unusual urban R&D mill with no conventional truck yard, and shadow obscures dock detail.
